test_harness_blocker_phase3.detail: subscription-lifecycle.test.js could not execute under `node --test` because it imported evaluateKeyRecordAccess() from index.js, which transitively imports pricing.js, which imports pricing-data.json without a `with {type:'json'}` import attribute -- fine for wrangler/esbuild, fatal for Node's native ESM loader (ERR_IMPORT_ATTRIBUTE_MISSING). Confirmed not test-file-specific by reproducing the same failure on the pre-existing, unrelated find-item-by-slug.test.js. Per the mission's explicit instruction not to blindly modify pricing.js, fixed via extraction: evaluateKeyRecordAccess() and its two Set constants moved to a new dependency-free workers/intel-gateway/src/subscription-lifecycle.js (zero imports of its own). index.js now imports from and re-exports this module unchanged -- single source of truth preserved, zero production behavior change.
